sloka: मनोरथः स्यादिति चिन्तयामि तथापि बुद्ध्या च वितर्कयामि ।किं कारणं तस्य हि नास्ति रूपं सुव्यक्तरूपश्च वदत्ययं माम् ।। ५.३२.१३।।।।
transliteration: manorathaḥ syāditi cintayāmi tathāpi buddhyā ca vitarkayāmi ।kiṁ kāraṇaṁ tasya hi nāsti rūpaṁ suvyaktarūpaśca vadatyayaṁ mām ।। 5.32.13।।।।

translations.english: "I feel it is only the desire in my mind. Desire has no form. But the one who is addressing me has a form. I cannot understand this.
